note: Built with the ledger of INSTALL-G12-INPUT-INVENTORY-nix-r0.1.md from one source. Caller variables are given to the leaf shell at LAUNCH (its process environment) and OBSERVED; the include context is install.sh's real prefix. Synthetic values only; the canary is a builtin that prints CANARY. A finite matrix is never claimed as proof for every environment.

variables.name: HOME
variables.consumer: default of --home, the unit directory, the private stage

variables.name: CORTEX_INSTALL_WAIT
variables.consumer: install.sh wait_max, used in a [ -lt ] test only
variables.note: documented nowhere; finding F2 does not touch it

variables.name: CORTEX_INSTALL_POLL
variables.consumer: install.sh poll: sleep AND $((waited + poll))
variables.note: finding F2: arithmetic evaluates a[$(...)]; vera's witness variable

variables.name: CORTEX_SCRIPTS_DIR
variables.consumer: where a CHECKOUT finds the backup scripts (ignored in release mode)

variables.name: CORTEX_LOG
variables.consumer: a file every say and warn line is appended to
variables.note: assigned from the caller at install.sh 26

variables.name: CORTEX_MIN_FREE_GIB
variables.consumer: machine_look disk threshold

variables.name: PREREQ_ROOT
variables.consumer: prefix of /etc, /sys, /proc, /dev/tty and the root stage
variables.note: a TEST HOOK read by shipped code (finding F4)

variables.name: CORTEX_DB_CONTAINER
variables.consumer: db-roles.sh, a HOST script run by install.sh: the caller's value passes through
variables.note: only a cv2-s5-* plain name is accepted there

variables.name: FETCH_BASE_URL
variables.consumer: rel_fetch reads it from the environment when CORTEX_FROM is empty
variables.note: finding F1b: a caller-reachable download location, which interface r1 and W1-84 say the installer must not read from the environment

variables.name: CORTEX_YES
variables.consumer: OVERWRITTEN at install.sh 26 before the includes
variables.note: the cells prove the caller value is not consumed

variables.name: CORTEX_RELEASE
variables.consumer: OVERWRITTEN at install.sh 26

variables.name: CORTEX_BASE_URL
variables.consumer: OVERWRITTEN at install.sh 26; set from --base-url only (interface r1, W1-84)

variables.name: CORTEX_FROM
variables.consumer: OVERWRITTEN at install.sh 26; set from --from

variables.name: CORTEX_CONFIG
variables.consumer: the caller value is seen until install.sh 312, where the installer exports its own derived path; compose (359) reads the derived value

variables.name: CORTEX_PORT
variables.consumer: the caller value is seen until install.sh 313, where the installer exports the --port value; compose reads that

variables.name: CORTEX_DUMP_STATUS
variables.consumer: the caller value is seen until install.sh 325, where the installer exports the derived path; compose reads that

variables.name: CORTEX_DUMPS
variables.consumer: UNSET by the installer at 326: no later consumer sees a caller value

variables.name: CORTEX_GIT_SHA
variables.consumer: the caller value is seen until install.sh 331, where the installer exports the derived value; compose reads that

variables.name: CORTEX_VERSION
variables.consumer: in release mode exported from stack.env at 271 (the caller value is overwritten there); in a checkout a caller value passes to compose
variables.note: release mode overwrites, a checkout passes

variables.name: CORTEX_SERVER_IMAGE
variables.consumer: exported from stack.env in release mode (271)

variables.name: CORTEX_DB_IMAGE
variables.consumer: exported from stack.env in release mode (271)

variables.name: PATH
variables.consumer: the shell; a real PATH is not tried in the oracle (nothing external can start there, by design)

variables.name: LC_ALL
variables.consumer: pinned per command in the prereq file

variables.name: LANG
variables.consumer: the shell's locale when LC_ALL is unset
variables.note: launch-phase; named in r0 section H and missing from r0's matrix

variables.name: SHELLOPTS
variables.consumer: the shell imports it at start
variables.note: launch-phase; the observed effective value is in the raw receipt

variables.name: BASHOPTS
variables.consumer: the shell imports it at start

variables.name: BASH_ENV
variables.consumer: read by a non-interactive bash that is not in POSIX mode

variables.name: ENV
variables.consumer: read by an interactive POSIX shell

variables.name: PS4
variables.consumer: the xtrace prefix; a restricted bash does not take PS4 from its environment, so the leaf shows its DEFAULT prefix and the cell is UNTESTABLE (no hostile value was ever applied)

variables.name: POSIXLY_CORRECT
variables.consumer: the shell

variables.name: CDPATH
variables.consumer: the shell (install.sh 56 sets it empty for one cd)

variables.name: GLOBIGNORE
variables.consumer: the shell
